commands.name: template-excludes-exactly-seven-ids
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; env=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')).get('env') or {}; ids={s.strip().lower() for s in env.get('ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS','').split(',') if s.strip()}; sys.exit(0 if ids=={'session-start:plan-canvas-sessions','stop:plan-canvas-pending','post:bash:command-log-audit','post:bash:command-log-cost','post:skill:track','pre:mcp-health-check','post:mcp-health-check'} else 1)"

commands.name: template-has-token-key
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; env=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')).get('env') or {}; sys.exit(0 if env.get('ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME')=='{{CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}}' and 'ECC_MCP_CONFIG_PATH' not in env and 'ECC_MCP_HEALTH_STATE_PATH' not in env else 1)"

commands.name: template-keeps-existing-env-keys
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; env=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['env']; sys.exit(0 if env.get('ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL')=='claude-opus-5[1m]' and env.get('CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TELEMETRY')=='1' and env.get('ECC_CONTEXT_MONITOR_COST_WARNINGS')=='0' else 1)"

commands.name: template-is-valid-json
commands.run: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))"

commands.name: links-suite
commands.run: sh install/claude-links.test.sh

commands.name: reconcile-leaves-no-token
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/cfg"; DOTFILEDIR="$(pwd)"; export DOTFILEDIR; . install/common/claude-links.sh; reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/cfg/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; ! grep -q 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}}' "$d/cfg/settings.json" && python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); sys.exit(0 if d['env']['ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME']==sys.argv[2] else 1)" "$d/cfg/settings.json" "$d/cfg"

commands.name: reconcile-converges
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/cfg"; DOTFILEDIR="$(pwd)"; export DOTFILEDIR; . install/common/claude-links.sh; reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/cfg/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; cp "$d/cfg/settings.json" "$d/first.json"; reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/cfg/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; cmp -s "$d/cfg/settings.json" "$d/first.json"

commands.name: hooks-suite-sandboxed
commands.run: HOME="$(mktemp -d)" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh

commands.name: hooks-suite-passes-on-reconciled-dir
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/.claude"; DOTFILEDIR="$(pwd)"; export DOTFILEDIR; . install/common/claude-links.sh; reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/.claude/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; HOME="$d" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err" && grep -q 'scopes ECC state to this config dir' "$d/out" && grep -q 'excludes the account-leaking ECC hooks' "$d/out"

commands.name: drift-fails-without-new-exclusion
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/.claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); e=t['env']; e['ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS']=e['ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS'].replace(',post:skill:track',''); e['ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME']=sys.argv[1]; json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1]+'/settings.json','w'), indent=2)" "$d/.claude"; if HOME="$d" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"; then exit 1; fi; grep -q 'does not exclude the account-leaking ECC hooks' "$d/err" && ! grep -q 'does not scope ECC state' "$d/err"

commands.name: drift-fails-on-foreign-data-home
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/.claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); t['env']['ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME']='/elsewhere/.claude'; json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1]+'/settings.json','w'), indent=2)" "$d/.claude"; if HOME="$d" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"; then exit 1; fi; grep -q 'does not scope ECC state to this config dir' "$d/err" && ! grep -q 'does not exclude the account-leaking' "$d/err"

commands.name: drift-fails-on-unsubstituted-token
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/.claude"; cp claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/.claude/settings.json"; if HOME="$d" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"; then exit 1; fi; grep -q 'does not scope ECC state to this config dir' "$d/err"

commands.name: new-suite-syntax
commands.run: sh -n claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh && test -f claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh

commands.name: isolation-suite
commands.run: ECC_HOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh

commands.name: isolation-suite-covers-every-planned-case
commands.run: out="$(ECC_HOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh 2>&1)" && for s in 'excluded: command-log audit/cost' 'excluded: skill-run tracker' 'excluded: mcp-health-check' 'scoped: cost-tracker metrics' 'scoped: session-activity metrics' 'scoped: session-end summary' 'scoped: compaction log' 'scoped: session-start data dir' 'flag gate: the seven excluded ids answer no' 'flag gate: TDD, dispatcher, GateGuard, and scoped ids stay enabled'; do printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "^PASS  $s" || { echo "missing: $s"; exit 1; }; done && test "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^PASS  control:')" -ge 8

commands.name: isolation-suite-skips-without-ecc
commands.run: out="$(ECC_PLUGIN_ROOT=/nonexistent sh claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh)" && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^SKIP: ' && ! ECC_PLUGIN_ROOT=/nonexistent ECC_HOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh >/dev/null 2>&1

commands.name: isolation-suite-fails-without-template-value
commands.run: test -f claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh || exit 1; d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); t['env'].pop('ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS', None); json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), indent=2)" "$d/claude/settings.json.tmpl"; if (cd "$d" && ECC_HOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh "$OLDPWD/claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh" >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"); then exit 1; fi; grep -q '^FAIL  excluded: command-log audit/cost' "$d/err" && grep -q '^FAIL  excluded: mcp-health-check' "$d/err" && grep -q '^FAIL  flag gate: the seven excluded ids answer no' "$d/err" && ! grep -q '^FAIL  scoped:' "$d/err"

commands.name: isolation-suite-fails-without-data-home-key
commands.run: test -f claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh || exit 1; d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); t['env'].pop('ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME', None); json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), indent=2)" "$d/claude/settings.json.tmpl"; if (cd "$d" && ECC_HOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh "$OLDPWD/claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh" >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"); then exit 1; fi; grep -q '^FAIL  scoped: cost-tracker metrics' "$d/err" && ! grep -q '^FAIL  excluded:' "$d/err"

commands.name: canvas-suite-still-passes
commands.run: PLAN_CANVAS_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh

commands.name: runner-registers-suite
commands.run: grep -qx 'sh claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh' bin/dotfiles-tests && grep -qx 'sh claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh' bin/dotfiles-tests

commands.name: claude-md-documents-isolation
commands.run: for s in ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh '{{CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}}' ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME post:skill:track post:bash:command-log-audit post:bash:command-log-cost pre:mcp-health-check post:mcp-health-check session-start:plan-canvas-sessions stop:plan-canvas-pending; do grep -qF "$s" CLAUDE.md || { echo "CLAUDE.md missing $s"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: shell-syntax-of-touched-scripts
commands.run: bash -n install/common/claude-links.sh && sh -n install/claude-links.test.sh && sh -n claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && bash -n bin/dotfiles-tests

commands.name: changed-files-within-scope
commands.run: git diff --name-only 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD | grep -v '^docs/' | grep -v '^claude/contracts/' | grep -vxE 'claude/settings.json.tmpl|install/common/claude-links.sh|install/claude-links.test.sh|claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh|claude/hooks/ecc-hook-isolation.test.sh|bin/dotfiles-tests|CLAUDE.md' | { ! grep -q .; }

commands.name: no-parallel-branch-edits
commands.run: ! git diff --name-only 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD | grep -qE '^(claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core\.py|claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/|claude/skills/co-review/|git/hooks/commit-msg$|install/common/codex-)'

commands.name: canvas-suite-untouched
commands.run: git diff --quiet 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD -- claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh

commands.name: no-emoji-in-changed-files
commands.run: git diff --name-only 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD | grep -v '^docs/' | while read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; LC_ALL=C grep -nP '[\x{1F300}-\x{1FAFF}\x{2600}-\x{27BF}]' "$f" && exit 1; done; exit 0
